EXO.P.2.1-10.text: The Birth and Adoption of Moses

EXO.P.2.11-22.text: The Rejection and Flight of Moses

EXO.P.2.23-25.text: God Hears the Cry of the Israelites

EXO.P.4.27-31.text: The People Believe Moses and Aaron

EXO.P.11.1-10.text: The Plague on the Firstborn Foretold

EXO.P.12.29-30.text: The Tenth Plague: Death of the Firstborn

EXO.P.13.17-22.text: The Pillars of Cloud and Fire

EXO.P.26.1-6.text: The Ten Curtains for the Tabernacle

EXO.P.26.7-14.text: The Eleven Curtains of Goat Hair

EXO.P.29.45-46.text: God Will Dwell among the People

EXO.P.36.1-7.text: The People Bring More than Enough

EXO.P.36.8-13.text: The Ten Curtains for the Tabernacle

EXO.P.36.14-19.text: The Eleven Curtains of Goat Hair

EXO.1.1-5.text: The sons of Jacob who went to Egypt are named

EXO.1.6-7.text: Joseph’s generation dies and the Israelites increase

EXO.1.8-10.text: A new king fears that the Israelites are too many

EXO.1.11-12.text: Egyptians oppress the Israelites, who still increase

EXO.1.13-14.text: Egyptians make the Israelites’ work harsh and bitter

EXO.1.15-17.text: The midwives fear God and refuse to kill the baby boys

EXO.1.18-19.text: Pharaoh asks the midwives why the boys live

EXO.1.20-22.text: God blesses the midwives, and Pharaoh orders boys drowned

EXO.2.1-2.text: A Levite woman bears a son and hides him three months

EXO.2.3-4.text: The mother puts the baby in a basket on the Nile

EXO.2.5-6.text: Pharaoh’s daughter finds the baby and feels pity

EXO.2.7-8.text: The baby’s sister offers to find a Hebrew nurse

EXO.2.9-10.text: Pharaoh’s daughter adopts the boy and names him Moses

EXO.2.11-12.text: Moses kills an Egyptian who was beating a Hebrew

EXO.2.13-14.text: A Hebrew rejects Moses, and Moses becomes afraid

EXO.2.15-17.text: Moses flees to Midian and helps the priest’s daughters

EXO.2.18-20.text: Reuel asks that Moses be invited to eat

EXO.2.21-22.text: Moses marries Zipporah and has a son, Gershom

EXO.2.23-25.text: God Hears the Cry of the Israelites

EXO.3.1-3.text: Moses sees a bush burning without burning up

EXO.3.4-6.text: God speaks to Moses from the bush on holy ground

EXO.3.7-8.text: God will rescue the Israelites from Egypt

EXO.3.9-10.text: God sends Moses to Pharaoh to bring out the Israelites

EXO.3.11-12.text: Moses doubts himself, but God promises to be with him

EXO.3.13-15.text: God gives Moses his name to tell the Israelites

EXO.3.16-18.text: God tells Moses to gather the elders and go to Pharaoh

EXO.3.19-22.text: God says Pharaoh will refuse, but Egypt will give wealth

EXO.4.1-3.text: God shows Moses a sign with a snake

EXO.4.4-5.text: Moses catches the snake, and it becomes a staff again

EXO.4.6-7.text: Moses’ hand becomes leprous and is then healed

EXO.4.8-9.text: God gives Moses a third sign with water from the Nile

EXO.4.10-13.text: Moses makes excuses, but God promises to help him speak

EXO.4.14-17.text: God is angry and says Aaron will speak for Moses

EXO.4.18-20.text: Moses leaves Jethro and returns to Egypt with his family

EXO.4.21-23.text: The LORD tells Moses to warn Pharaoh about his firstborn

EXO.4.24-26.text: The LORD threatens Moses, and Zipporah circumcises her son

EXO.4.27-28.text: Aaron meets Moses at the mountain of God

EXO.4.29-31.text: The Israelites believe Moses and Aaron and worship

EXO.5.1-2.text: Moses and Aaron ask Pharaoh to let the people go

EXO.5.3-5.text: Pharaoh tells Moses and Aaron to get back to work

EXO.5.6-9.text: Pharaoh makes the Israelites find straw for bricks

EXO.5.10-11.text: Taskmasters tell the Israelites to find straw themselves

EXO.5.12-14.text: The Israelite foremen are beaten for missing the quota

EXO.5.15-18.text: Pharaoh calls the foremen slackers and refuses help

EXO.5.19-21.text: The foremen blame Moses and Aaron for the trouble

EXO.5.22-23.text: Moses asks the LORD why the people suffer more

EXO.6.1-1.text: The LORD says Pharaoh will let the people go

EXO.6.2-5.text: God tells Moses he remembers the covenant with Abraham

EXO.6.6-7.text: God promises to bring the Israelites out of Egypt

EXO.6.8-9.text: God promises the land, but the Israelites do not listen

EXO.6.10-13.text: God sends Moses to Pharaoh, but Moses doubts

EXO.6.14-15.text: The clans of Reuben and Simeon

EXO.6.16-19.text: The clans of Levi: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari

EXO.6.20-22.text: The descendants of Amram, Izhar, and Uzziel

EXO.6.23-25.text: Aaron’s sons and other Levite family heads

EXO.6.26-27.text: Moses and Aaron are the men who spoke to Pharaoh

EXO.6.28-30.text: Moses again doubts that Pharaoh will listen

EXO.7.1-2.text: The LORD makes Moses like God and Aaron his prophet

EXO.7.3-5.text: The LORD says Pharaoh will refuse, but Israel will leave

EXO.7.6-7.text: Moses and Aaron obey the LORD and speak to Pharaoh

EXO.7.8-10.text: Aaron’s staff becomes a serpent before Pharaoh

EXO.7.11-13.text: Aaron’s staff swallows the staffs of the magicians

EXO.7.14-15.text: The LORD tells Moses to meet Pharaoh at the Nile

EXO.7.16-18.text: Moses must warn Pharaoh that the Nile will turn to blood

EXO.7.19-19.text: All the water in Egypt will become blood

EXO.7.20-22.text: Aaron strikes the Nile and the water becomes blood

EXO.7.23-25.text: The Egyptians dig along the Nile for water to drink

EXO.8.1-4.text: God tells Moses to warn Pharaoh about frogs

EXO.8.5-7.text: Aaron brings frogs, and the magicians do the same

EXO.8.8-9.text: Pharaoh asks Moses to pray for the frogs to go away

EXO.8.10-12.text: Moses promises the frogs will leave tomorrow

EXO.8.13-15.text: The frogs die, but Pharaoh hardens his heart

EXO.8.16-17.text: Aaron strikes the dust and it becomes gnats

EXO.8.18-19.text: Magicians cannot make gnats, and Pharaoh will not listen

EXO.8.20-21.text: God tells Moses to warn Pharaoh about flies

EXO.8.22-24.text: God protects Goshen, but flies fill Egypt

EXO.8.25-27.text: Pharaoh says to sacrifice in Egypt, but Moses says no

EXO.8.28-29.text: Pharaoh agrees to let Israel go if Moses prays

EXO.8.30-32.text: God removes the flies, but Pharaoh hardens his heart

EXO.9.1-4.text: God warns Pharaoh of a plague on Egypt’s animals

EXO.9.5-7.text: Egypt’s animals die, but Israel’s animals live

EXO.9.8-10.text: Moses throws soot in the air and boils break out

EXO.9.11-12.text: The magicians get boils, and God hardens Pharaoh’s heart

EXO.9.13-14.text: God tells Moses to warn Pharaoh of more plagues

EXO.9.15-17.text: God says he raised up Pharaoh to show his power

EXO.9.18-19.text: God warns Pharaoh of terrible hail tomorrow

EXO.9.20-21.text: Officials who fear God shelter servants and animals

EXO.9.22-24.text: Moses stretches out his staff, and hail falls on Egypt

EXO.9.25-26.text: The hail destroys everything in Egypt except Goshen

EXO.9.27-28.text: Pharaoh admits his sin and asks Moses to pray

EXO.9.29-30.text: Moses agrees to pray, but knows Pharaoh does not fear God

EXO.9.31-33.text: Flax and barley are ruined, and Moses stops the hail

EXO.9.34-35.text: Pharaoh sins again and will not let Israel go

EXO.10.1-2.text: God tells Moses why he hardened Pharaoh’s heart

EXO.10.3-4.text: Moses and Aaron warn Pharaoh about locusts

EXO.10.5-6.text: Moses describes how locusts will cover Egypt

EXO.10.7-8.text: Officials urge Pharaoh to let the Israelites go

EXO.10.9-11.text: Pharaoh will let only the men go worship

EXO.10.12-13.text: Moses raises his staff and an east wind brings locusts

EXO.10.14-15.text: Locusts cover Egypt and eat every plant and tree

EXO.10.16-18.text: Pharaoh confesses his sin and asks Moses to pray

EXO.10.19-20.text: A strong wind removes the locusts, but Pharaoh refuses

EXO.10.21-23.text: Darkness covers Egypt for three days, but not Israel

EXO.10.24-26.text: Moses says all the livestock must go too

EXO.10.27-29.text: Pharaoh orders Moses to leave and never return

EXO.11.1-3.text: God promises one more plague before Israel leaves

EXO.11.4-5.text: Moses says every firstborn son in Egypt will die

EXO.11.6-8.text: Egypt will cry out, but Israel will be safe

EXO.11.9-10.text: The LORD says Pharaoh will not listen to Moses

EXO.12.1-2.text: The LORD makes this month the first month of the year

EXO.12.3-4.text: Israelite families must choose a lamb on the tenth day

EXO.12.5-8.text: Israel must kill the lambs and put blood on doorframes

EXO.12.9-11.text: Israelites must eat the lamb roasted, ready to travel

EXO.12.12-13.text: The LORD will pass over houses marked with blood

EXO.12.14-14.text: Israel must keep this day as a feast for all time

EXO.12.15-16.text: Israel must eat unleavened bread for seven days

EXO.12.17-18.text: Israel must keep the Feast of Unleavened Bread each year

EXO.12.19-20.text: No one in Israel may eat leavened bread for seven days

EXO.12.21-22.text: Moses tells Israel’s elders how to use the lamb’s blood

EXO.12.23-23.text: The LORD will protect houses marked with blood

EXO.12.24-25.text: Israel must keep this service in the promised land

EXO.12.26-28.text: Israelites must teach children the meaning of Passover

EXO.12.29-30.text: The Tenth Plague: Death of the Firstborn

EXO.12.31-33.text: Pharaoh tells Israel to leave Egypt at night

EXO.12.34-36.text: Egyptians give Israelites silver, gold and clothing

EXO.12.37-40.text: About 600,000 Israelite men leave Egypt with many others

EXO.12.41-42.text: After 430 years, the LORD brings Israel out of Egypt

EXO.12.43-44.text: Foreigners may not eat the Passover; bought slaves may

EXO.12.45-46.text: The Passover must be eaten inside one house

EXO.12.47-48.text: A foreigner must be circumcised to celebrate the Passover

EXO.12.49-51.text: The same law applies to Israelites and foreigners

EXO.13.1-2.text: God tells Moses to set apart every firstborn male

EXO.13.3-5.text: Moses tells Israel to remember the day of leaving Egypt

EXO.13.6-7.text: Moses tells Israel to keep a feast on the seventh day

EXO.13.8-10.text: Israelites must tell sons what the LORD did in Egypt

EXO.13.11-13.text: Israelites must give or redeem firstborn males

EXO.13.14-16.text: Fathers must tell sons how the LORD freed Israel

EXO.13.17-18.text: God leads the Israelites toward the Red Sea

EXO.13.19-22.text: The LORD leads Israel with cloud by day, fire by night

EXO.14.1-3.text: The LORD tells Moses to camp by the sea

EXO.14.4-5.text: Pharaoh regrets letting the Israelites go

EXO.14.6-9.text: Pharaoh and his army chase the Israelites

EXO.14.10-12.text: The Israelites are afraid and blame Moses

EXO.14.13-14.text: Moses tells Israel not to fear; the LORD will fight

EXO.14.15-18.text: The LORD tells Moses to divide the sea

EXO.14.19-20.text: The cloud separates the Egyptians from Israel

EXO.14.21-22.text: Israel walks through the sea on dry ground

EXO.14.23-25.text: The LORD confuses the Egyptian army in the sea

EXO.14.26-28.text: The sea covers Pharaoh’s army and none survive

EXO.14.29-31.text: Israel sees the Egyptians dead and believes the LORD

EXO.15.1-1.text: Moses and the Israelites sing to the LORD

EXO.15.2-3.text: The song praises the LORD as strength and warrior

EXO.15.4-5.text: The LORD threw Pharaoh’s army into the sea

EXO.15.6-8.text: The LORD’s power destroys the enemy; waters pile up

EXO.15.9-11.text: The enemy boasted, but the LORD is greater than all gods

EXO.15.12-13.text: The LORD will lead his people to his holy dwelling

EXO.15.14-15.text: Nations near Canaan will tremble in fear

EXO.15.16-16.text: Fear will stop the nations until Israel passes by

EXO.15.17-18.text: The LORD will plant Israel on his mountain and reign

EXO.15.19-21.text: Miriam leads the women in singing and dancing

EXO.15.22-23.text: Israel finds only bitter water at Marah

EXO.15.24-26.text: The LORD sweetens the water and tests Israel

EXO.15.27-27.text: Israel camps at Elim by twelve springs

EXO.16.1-3.text: Israelites grumble against Moses and Aaron for food

EXO.16.4-5.text: The LORD promises bread from heaven each day

EXO.16.6-8.text: Moses and Aaron say the LORD has heard the grumbling

EXO.16.9-12.text: The LORD’s glory appears and he promises meat and bread

EXO.16.13-15.text: Quail cover the camp and the Israelites see manna

EXO.16.16-18.text: Each Israelite gathers only as much as he needs

EXO.16.19-21.text: Some Israelites keep manna until morning and it spoils

EXO.16.22-23.text: Moses says the next day is a holy Sabbath rest

EXO.16.24-25.text: Manna kept for the Sabbath does not spoil

EXO.16.26-27.text: Some Israelites find no manna on the seventh day

EXO.16.28-30.text: The LORD tells the people to rest on the seventh day

EXO.16.31-32.text: The bread is named manna, and Moses orders some kept

EXO.16.33-36.text: Aaron puts a jar of manna before the LORD

EXO.17.1-3.text: The people have no water and complain to Moses

EXO.17.4-7.text: God tells Moses to strike the rock for water

EXO.17.8-10.text: The Amalekites attack, and Joshua goes out to fight

EXO.17.11-13.text: Aaron and Hur hold up Moses’ hands while Israel wins

EXO.17.14-16.text: Moses writes a reminder and builds an altar

EXO.18.1-4.text: Jethro hears about God’s work and brings Moses’ family

EXO.18.5-6.text: Jethro comes to Moses at the mountain of God

EXO.18.7-8.text: Moses greets Jethro and tells him what the LORD did

EXO.18.9-11.text: Jethro praises the LORD as greater than all gods

EXO.18.12-12.text: Jethro offers sacrifices, and the leaders eat with him

EXO.18.13-14.text: Jethro sees Moses judging the people all day

EXO.18.15-16.text: Moses explains why the people come to him

EXO.18.17-20.text: Jethro warns Moses that the work is too heavy for him

EXO.18.21-23.text: Jethro tells Moses to appoint capable leaders

EXO.18.24-27.text: Moses follows Jethro’s advice and appoints judges

EXO.19.1-2.text: The Israelites arrive at the Wilderness of Sinai

EXO.19.3-6.text: If Israel obeys, Israel will be God’s treasured people

EXO.19.7-9.text: The people promise to do all the LORD has said

EXO.19.10-11.text: Moses must make the people ready for the LORD’s coming

EXO.19.12-13.text: Moses must set a boundary around the mountain

EXO.19.14-15.text: Moses prepares the people for the third day

EXO.19.16-18.text: The LORD comes down on Mount Sinai in fire and smoke

EXO.19.19-22.text: The LORD calls Moses up and warns the people

EXO.19.23-25.text: Moses goes down to the people with the LORD’s warning

EXO.20.1-3.text: God says the Israelites must have no other gods

EXO.20.4-6.text: God forbids the Israelites to make or worship idols

EXO.20.7-7.text: God forbids the Israelites to misuse his name

EXO.20.8-11.text: God commands the Israelites to keep the Sabbath holy

EXO.20.12-14.text: Israel must honor parents and not murder or commit adultery

EXO.20.15-17.text: Israelites must not steal, lie, or want what others own

EXO.20.22-23.text: God tells the Israelites not to make gods of silver or gold

EXO.20.24-26.text: God gives the Israelites rules for building an altar

EXO.21.1-1.text: God gives Moses laws to set before the Israelites

EXO.21.2-4.text: A Hebrew servant goes free after six years

EXO.21.5-6.text: A servant who loves his master may serve for life

EXO.21.7-8.text: Rules for a man who sells his daughter as a servant

EXO.21.9-11.text: A servant woman must be treated fairly or go free

EXO.21.12-14.text: Laws about killing a man on purpose or by accident

EXO.21.15-17.text: Hitting or cursing parents and kidnapping bring death

EXO.21.18-19.text: A man who hurts another must pay for lost work

EXO.21.20-21.text: Rules for a master who strikes a servant with a rod

EXO.21.22-25.text: Laws about harming a pregnant woman and serious injury

EXO.21.26-27.text: A master must free a servant whose eye or tooth he harms

EXO.21.28-30.text: Rules about an ox that kills a man or woman

EXO.21.31-32.text: Rules for an ox that gores a child or a servant

EXO.21.33-34.text: A man must pay for an animal that falls into his pit

EXO.21.35-36.text: Rules when one man’s ox kills another man’s ox

EXO.22.1-4.text: A thief must pay back more than he stole

EXO.22.5-5.text: A man must pay for his animals that eat another’s field

EXO.22.6-6.text: A man must pay for a fire that burns another’s grain

EXO.22.7-9.text: Rules for stolen goods kept safe for a neighbor

EXO.22.10-13.text: Rules for an animal that dies in a neighbor’s care

EXO.22.14-15.text: A man must pay for a borrowed animal that is hurt

EXO.22.16-17.text: A man who seduces a virgin must pay the bride price

EXO.22.18-19.text: Sorcery and sex with an animal are punished by death

EXO.22.20-21.text: Israel must not worship other gods or oppress foreigners

EXO.22.22-24.text: God warns Israel not to mistreat widows and orphans

EXO.22.25-27.text: Israelites must not charge interest to poor people

EXO.22.28-28.text: Israelites must not curse God or the ruler

EXO.22.29-31.text: Israelites must give God the firstborn and offerings

EXO.23.1-3.text: Israelites must not lie in court or follow the crowd

EXO.23.4-5.text: Israelites must help an enemy’s lost or fallen animal

EXO.23.6-9.text: Israelites must be fair to the poor and foreigners

EXO.23.10-11.text: Israelites must let the land rest every seventh year

EXO.23.12-13.text: Israelites must rest on the seventh day and honor God alone

EXO.23.14-15.text: Israelites must keep the Feast of Unleavened Bread

EXO.23.16-17.text: Israelites must keep the Feasts of Harvest and Ingathering

EXO.23.18-19.text: Israelites must follow rules for sacrifices and firstfruits

EXO.23.20-22.text: God sends an angel and tells Israelites to obey him

EXO.23.23-25.text: Israelites must not serve the gods of the nations

EXO.23.26-29.text: God will drive out the nations, not in one year

EXO.23.30-33.text: Israelites must not make a covenant with the nations

EXO.24.1-2.text: God calls Moses and seventy elders to worship at a distance

EXO.24.3-4.text: The people promise to obey, and Moses builds an altar

EXO.24.5-6.text: Young men offer sacrifices and Moses sprinkles blood

EXO.24.7-8.text: Moses reads the covenant and sprinkles blood on the people

EXO.24.9-11.text: Moses and the leaders see God and eat and drink

EXO.24.12-13.text: God calls Moses up the mountain to receive the tablets

EXO.24.14-15.text: Moses tells the elders to wait and goes up the mountain

EXO.24.16-18.text: God’s glory covers Mount Sinai and Moses stays forty days

EXO.25.1-2.text: God tells Moses to ask Israelites for offerings

EXO.25.3-7.text: God lists the materials for the offering

EXO.25.8-9.text: Israelites are to build a sanctuary where God will live

EXO.25.10-11.text: Israelites are to make an ark of acacia wood and gold

EXO.25.12-14.text: The ark gets gold rings and poles for carrying

EXO.25.15-16.text: The poles stay in the rings; the Testimony goes in the ark

EXO.25.17-18.text: Israelites are to make a gold mercy seat with two cherubim

EXO.25.19-21.text: The cherubim face each other over the mercy seat

EXO.25.22-22.text: God will meet and speak with Moses at the mercy seat

EXO.25.23-24.text: God tells Moses to make a table of acacia wood and gold

EXO.25.25-27.text: God tells Moses to add a rim and rings to the table

EXO.25.28-30.text: Moses must make carrying poles and gold dishes for the table

EXO.25.31-32.text: God tells Moses to make a gold lampstand with six branches

EXO.25.33-34.text: The lampstand branches are to have cups like almond blossoms

EXO.25.35-36.text: The lampstand buds and branches are one piece of gold

EXO.25.37-40.text: Moses must make seven lamps and follow the pattern

EXO.26.1-3.text: Moses must make ten linen curtains for the tabernacle

EXO.26.4-6.text: Moses must join the curtains with loops and gold clasps

EXO.26.7-9.text: Moses must make eleven goat hair curtains for the tent

EXO.26.10-11.text: Moses must join the goat hair curtains with bronze clasps

EXO.26.12-14.text: The extra curtain hangs down, and two more covers are made

EXO.26.15-18.text: Moses must make acacia wood frames for the tabernacle

EXO.26.19-21.text: Each frame on the south and north sides has two silver bases

EXO.26.22-25.text: Moses must make eight frames for the west side

EXO.26.26-28.text: Moses must make acacia wood crossbars for the frames

EXO.26.29-30.text: Moses must cover the frames with gold and follow the pattern

EXO.26.31-33.text: Moses must make a veil to separate the two holy rooms

EXO.26.34-35.text: God tells Moses where to put the mercy seat, table and lampstand

EXO.27.1-2.text: God tells Moses to build an altar of acacia wood

EXO.27.3-4.text: Moses must make bronze utensils and a grate for the altar

EXO.27.5-6.text: Moses must set the grate and make carrying poles for the altar

EXO.27.7-8.text: Moses must put the poles in the rings and make a hollow altar

EXO.27.9-10.text: Moses must make linen curtains for the south side of the courtyard

EXO.27.11-13.text: Moses must make the north, west and east sides of the courtyard

EXO.27.14-16.text: Moses must make the courtyard gate and its side curtains

EXO.27.17-19.text: The courtyard posts, size and bronze utensils are described

EXO.28.1-3.text: God chooses Aaron and his sons as priests and orders holy garments

EXO.28.4-5.text: God lists the garments for Aaron and his sons

EXO.28.6-9.text: Moses must make the ephod and two onyx stones

EXO.28.10-12.text: The names of Israel’s sons are engraved on the shoulder stones

EXO.28.13-14.text: Moses must make gold settings and two gold chains

EXO.28.15-16.text: Moses must make a square breastpiece of judgment

EXO.28.17-20.text: Moses must set four rows of gemstones on the breastpiece

EXO.28.21-24.text: Moses makes gold chains and rings for the breastpiece

EXO.28.25-26.text: Moses attaches the breastpiece to the ephod with chains

EXO.28.27-28.text: A blue cord ties the breastpiece to the ephod

EXO.28.29-30.text: Aaron wears the names of Israel’s sons over his heart

EXO.28.31-32.text: Moses makes a blue robe to go with the ephod

EXO.28.33-35.text: Aaron’s robe has bells and pomegranates on the hem

EXO.28.36-38.text: Aaron wears a gold plate marked Holy to the LORD

EXO.28.39-39.text: Moses makes the tunic, turban and sash of fine linen

EXO.28.40-41.text: Aaron’s sons get garments and are made priests

EXO.28.42-43.text: Aaron and his sons must wear linen undergarments

EXO.29.1-2.text: Moses must prepare animals and bread for the priests

EXO.29.3-4.text: Moses washes Aaron and his sons at the Tent entrance

EXO.29.5-7.text: Moses clothes Aaron and anoints him with oil

EXO.29.8-9.text: Moses clothes Aaron’s sons and ordains the priests

EXO.29.10-11.text: Aaron and his sons lay hands on the bull’s head

EXO.29.12-14.text: Moses offers the bull as a sin offering

EXO.29.15-18.text: Moses offers the first ram as a burnt offering

EXO.29.19-20.text: Moses puts the second ram’s blood on Aaron and his sons

EXO.29.21-21.text: Moses sprinkles blood and oil on Aaron and his sons

EXO.29.22-23.text: Moses takes parts of the ram and bread for the offering

EXO.29.24-25.text: Aaron and his sons wave the offerings before the LORD

EXO.29.26-28.text: The ram’s breast and thigh belong to Aaron and his sons

EXO.29.29-30.text: Aaron’s holy garments pass to his sons

EXO.29.31-34.text: Aaron and his sons eat the ordination meat and bread

EXO.29.35-37.text: For seven days Moses ordains priests and purifies the altar

EXO.29.38-39.text: Priests offer two lambs on the altar each day

EXO.29.40-40.text: The first lamb is offered with flour, oil and wine

EXO.29.41-42.text: The evening lamb is offered where God meets Moses

EXO.29.43-44.text: God will meet the Israelites and make the Tent holy

EXO.29.45-46.text: God Will Dwell among the People

EXO.30.1-2.text: Moses makes an altar of acacia wood for incense

EXO.30.3-4.text: Moses covers the incense altar with gold and adds rings

EXO.30.5-6.text: Moses places the incense altar before the veil

EXO.30.7-9.text: Aaron burns incense on the altar morning and evening

EXO.30.10-10.text: Aaron makes atonement on the altar once a year

EXO.30.11-14.text: Each Israelite man counted must pay half a shekel

EXO.30.15-16.text: Rich and poor Israelites give the same offering

EXO.30.17-18.text: The LORD tells Moses to make a bronze basin

EXO.30.19-21.text: Aaron and his sons must wash hands and feet before serving

EXO.30.22-25.text: The LORD tells Moses how to make the sacred anointing oil

EXO.30.26-28.text: Moses is to anoint the Tent and its furnishings with oil

EXO.30.29-31.text: Moses must anoint Aaron and his sons as priests

EXO.30.32-33.text: No one may copy the sacred oil or put it on outsiders

EXO.30.34-36.text: The LORD tells Moses how to make the incense

EXO.30.37-38.text: Israelites must not make this incense for enjoyment

EXO.31.1-2.text: The LORD calls Bezalel of Judah by name

EXO.31.3-5.text: God fills Bezalel with the Spirit and skill for crafts

EXO.31.6-9.text: God chooses Oholiab and gives skill to all the craftsmen

EXO.31.10-11.text: The craftsmen are to make the priests’ clothes and incense

EXO.31.12-15.text: The LORD tells the Israelites to keep the Sabbath

EXO.31.16-17.text: The Sabbath is a lasting sign between God and Israel

EXO.32.1-2.text: The Israelites ask Aaron to make gods when Moses is late

EXO.32.3-4.text: Aaron makes a gold calf from the people’s earrings

EXO.32.5-6.text: Aaron builds an altar and the people hold a feast

EXO.32.7-8.text: The LORD tells Moses that the people worship a calf

EXO.32.9-11.text: The LORD plans to destroy the people; Moses pleads

EXO.32.12-14.text: The LORD does not harm the people because Moses prays

EXO.32.15-16.text: Moses comes down the mountain with the two tablets

EXO.32.17-18.text: Joshua hears noise in the camp, and Moses hears singing

EXO.32.19-20.text: Moses breaks the tablets and destroys the calf

EXO.32.21-24.text: Moses questions Aaron, who blames the people

EXO.32.25-27.text: Moses orders the Levites to kill those who sinned

EXO.32.28-29.text: About three thousand die, and the Levites are blessed

EXO.32.30-32.text: Moses asks the LORD to forgive the people’s sin

EXO.32.33-35.text: The LORD will punish sin and sends a plague

EXO.33.1-3.text: The LORD will not go with the Israelites to the land

EXO.33.4-6.text: The Israelites mourn and take off jewelry

EXO.33.7-9.text: The LORD speaks with Moses at the tent outside the camp

EXO.33.10-11.text: The people worship as the LORD speaks with Moses

EXO.33.12-13.text: Moses asks the LORD to show him the LORD’s ways

EXO.33.14-16.text: The LORD promises to go with Moses and the people

EXO.33.17-18.text: The LORD agrees, and Moses asks to see God’s glory

EXO.33.19-20.text: The LORD says Moses cannot see God’s face and live

EXO.33.21-23.text: The LORD will hide Moses in a rock as his glory passes

EXO.34.1-2.text: The LORD tells Moses to cut two new stone tablets

EXO.34.3-4.text: Moses goes up Mount Sinai alone with the two tablets

EXO.34.5-7.text: The LORD passes Moses and proclaims his name

EXO.34.8-9.text: Moses worships and asks the LORD to forgive the people

EXO.34.10-11.text: The LORD makes a covenant and promises wonders

EXO.34.12-14.text: Israel must not make treaties or worship other gods

EXO.34.15-17.text: Israel must not marry into peoples who worship idols

EXO.34.18-18.text: Israel must keep the Feast of Unleavened Bread

EXO.34.19-20.text: The LORD says the firstborn belong to him

EXO.34.21-22.text: Israel must rest on the seventh day and keep two feasts

EXO.34.23-24.text: Israel’s men must go to the LORD three times a year

EXO.34.25-26.text: The LORD gives rules about sacrifices and firstfruits

EXO.34.27-28.text: Moses writes the covenant words on the tablets

EXO.34.29-31.text: Moses’ face shines and the Israelites are afraid

EXO.34.32-33.text: Moses gives the LORD’s commands, then veils his face

EXO.34.34-35.text: Moses removes the veil when he speaks with the LORD

EXO.35.10-12.text: Skilled workers must make the tabernacle and the ark

EXO.35.13-16.text: Skilled workers must make the table, lampstand and altars

EXO.35.17-19.text: Workers must make the courtyard and the priests’ clothes

EXO.35.20-22.text: The Israelites bring gold jewelry for the LORD’s work

EXO.35.23-24.text: The people bring cloth, skins, metal and wood

EXO.35.25-26.text: Skilled women spin yarn and goat hair for the work

EXO.35.27-29.text: Leaders and people give stones, spices and oil freely

EXO.35.30-33.text: The LORD has filled Bezalel with skill for crafts

EXO.35.34-35.text: The LORD gives Bezalel and Oholiab skill to teach others

EXO.36.1-1.text: Bezalel, Oholiab and others will build the sanctuary

EXO.36.2-4.text: Moses calls the skilled workers to begin the work

EXO.36.5-7.text: The people are told to stop bringing offerings

EXO.36.8-10.text: The craftsmen make ten linen curtains for the tabernacle

EXO.36.11-13.text: The craftsmen join the curtains with loops and gold clasps

EXO.36.14-17.text: The craftsmen make eleven curtains of goat hair

EXO.36.18-19.text: The craftsmen make bronze clasps and two coverings for the tent

EXO.36.20-23.text: The craftsmen make acacia frames for the tabernacle

EXO.36.24-26.text: The craftsmen make silver bases for the frames

EXO.36.27-28.text: The craftsmen make frames for the back of the tabernacle

EXO.36.29-30.text: The craftsmen join the corner frames and set them on bases

EXO.36.31-34.text: The craftsmen make gold-covered crossbars for the frames

EXO.37.1-3.text: Bezalel makes the ark of acacia wood and gold

EXO.37.4-5.text: Bezalel makes poles for carrying the ark

EXO.37.6-6.text: Bezalel makes the mercy seat of pure gold

EXO.37.7-9.text: Bezalel makes two gold cherubim on the mercy seat

EXO.37.10-13.text: Bezalel makes the gold-covered table with rings

EXO.37.14-16.text: Bezalel makes poles and gold utensils for the table

EXO.37.17-19.text: Bezalel makes the gold lampstand with six branches

EXO.37.20-22.text: Bezalel adds cups and buds to the lampstand

EXO.37.23-24.text: Bezalel makes the lamps and tools from one talent of gold

EXO.37.25-26.text: Bezalel makes the square altar of incense

EXO.37.27-29.text: Bezalel makes poles, anointing oil and incense

EXO.38.1-3.text: Bezalel makes the bronze altar and its utensils

EXO.38.4-5.text: Bezalel makes a bronze grate and rings for the altar

EXO.38.6-7.text: Bezalel makes bronze-covered poles for the altar

EXO.38.9-10.text: The craftsmen make the south side of the courtyard

EXO.38.11-12.text: The craftsmen make the north and west sides of the courtyard

EXO.38.13-16.text: The craftsmen make the east side of the courtyard

EXO.38.17-20.text: The craftsmen finish the posts, entrance curtain and pegs

EXO.38.21-23.text: The tabernacle inventory names Bezalel and Oholiab

EXO.38.24-26.text: The gold and silver given for the sanctuary are counted

EXO.38.27-29.text: The silver is used for bases and hooks; bronze is counted

EXO.38.30-31.text: The bronze is used for bases, the altar and tent pegs

EXO.39.1-1.text: The workers made the holy clothes for Aaron

EXO.39.2-3.text: Bezalel made the ephod of linen, gold and colored yarn

EXO.39.4-5.text: The workers added shoulder pieces and a waistband

EXO.39.6-7.text: The workers put engraved onyx stones on the ephod

EXO.39.8-9.text: The workers made a square breastpiece

EXO.39.10-13.text: Workers mounted four rows of gemstones on the breastpiece

EXO.39.14-16.text: The twelve stones carried the names of Israel’s tribes

EXO.39.17-18.text: The workers fastened the gold chains to the shoulder pieces

EXO.39.19-20.text: The workers made four more gold rings

EXO.39.21-21.text: Workers tied the breastpiece to the ephod with a blue cord

EXO.39.22-24.text: The workers made the blue robe with pomegranates on the hem

EXO.39.25-26.text: The workers added gold bells between the pomegranates

EXO.39.27-29.text: The workers made linen clothes for Aaron and his sons

EXO.39.30-31.text: The workers made a gold plate marked Holy to the LORD

EXO.39.32-35.text: Israel finished the tabernacle and brought it to Moses

EXO.39.36-39.text: Israel brought the table, lampstand and altars to Moses

EXO.39.40-41.text: Israel brought the courtyard and priests’ clothes to Moses

EXO.39.42-43.text: Moses saw the finished work and blessed the Israelites

EXO.40.1-2.text: The LORD told Moses when to set up the tabernacle

EXO.40.3-4.text: Moses must put the ark, table and lampstand in the tent

EXO.40.5-7.text: Moses must set up the altars, the basin and the curtain

EXO.40.8-11.text: Moses must set up the courtyard and anoint everything

EXO.40.12-13.text: Moses must wash and clothe Aaron to serve as priest

EXO.40.14-16.text: Moses must also clothe and anoint Aaron’s sons as priests

EXO.40.17-20.text: Moses set up the tabernacle and the ark

EXO.40.21-23.text: Moses placed the ark, the veil and the table

EXO.40.24-25.text: Moses placed the lampstand and set up the lamps

EXO.40.26-27.text: Moses placed the gold altar and burned incense on it

EXO.40.28-30.text: Moses placed the altar and basin and made offerings

EXO.40.31-33.text: Priests washed at the basin, and Moses finished the work

EXO.40.34-35.text: The cloud covered the tent and the LORD’s glory filled it

EXO.40.36-38.text: The cloud showed the Israelites when to travel
